title: bug: JetBrains board ignores revision-only plan updates
description: MoeToolWindowPanel updateBoard and updateColumn fingerprints omit planRevision and step descriptions (lines 462–464, 706–708). A plan edit that only changes step text/revision skips rebuilding cards and leaves the rendered approval snapshot stale until some other field changes; CQ-F04c safely sends the old revision, so daemon CAS refuses it. Include plan revision in both fingerprints and cover revision-only refresh.
definitionOfDone: Revision-only plan updates refresh the board and column snapshots; regression tests cover the refresh without unrelated task field changes.

comments.author: worker-9cda703c
comments.content: CQ-F04c self-review fixed a related in-scope issue: unchanged destination-column callbacks could retain a task's old PLANNING status and send token-free UPDATE_TASK after the source became AWAITING_APPROVAL. Every column key now includes visible awaiting ids + revisions via approvalFingerprint. This follow-up still needs the OUTER boardFingerprint to recognize revision-only plan edits (it can early-return before that column processing); preserve rendered-token semantics and add a refresh regression.
